node_followup.request: Draw an AI agent architecture with tools and memory, then suggest useful questions for the first component.

accepted_components.title: AI Agent with Tools and Memory (Prototype)
assumptions: Educational prototype of a task-solving AI agent: a user submits a task and the agent plans and executes steps to answer it.
Tools include read-oriented retrieval (search, document fetch) and at least one action API, so the agent can mutate an external system through the tool executor.
Memory is split into short-range task context and a curated long-range fact store; both are read and written at runtime.
No feedback-driven update of models, prompts, rankings, or live configuration; memory writes do not retrain or retune the planner.
Prototype scope: single-tenant, no production hardening, no human confirmation gate, no deployment topology.

components.label: User Task Client
components.responsibility: Lets a user submit a task and view the agent's plan progress and final answer.

components.label: Agent Planner
components.responsibility: AI planner that analyzes the task, picks the next step or tool, reflects on results, and composes the final answer.

components.label: Tool Executor
components.responsibility: Invokes planner-selected tools with arguments, enforces basic guardrails, and returns tool results to the planner.

components.label: External Tools and APIs
components.responsibility: Environment the agent acts on: search, document fetch, and action APIs that can read or mutate external systems.

components.label: Short-Term Task Memory
components.responsibility: Holds the current task context, intermediate steps, and tool results within the context window budget.

components.label: Long-Term Fact Memory
components.responsibility: Stores curated durable facts and prior outcomes the planner retrieves and reuses across tasks.

components.label: Run Trace Log
components.responsibility: Records plans, tool calls, and outcomes so prototype runs can be inspected and debugged.

edges.label: store intermediate steps and tool results
store curated facts and task outcome
next tool step with exact action scope
audit guardrail decision and tool outcome

findings.reason: Long-Term Fact Memory (n6) is retrieved and reused across tasks by the planner, but the 'store curated facts and task outcome' edge writes directly from the planner to n6 with no gate, review, or acceptance step in the candidate records. Labeling the write 'curated' does not substitute for an explicit accepted post-gate artifact path or an identity/version-scoped route back through a gate before reuse.

edges.label: store intermediate steps and tool results
next tool step with exact action scope
audit guardrail decision and tool outcome

findings.reason: Assumptions declare that long-term fact memory (n6) is both read and written at runtime, but the candidate edges only show retrieval from n6 (n2->n6, n6->n2); there is no edge that writes curated facts or outcomes back into n6. The declared curation/reuse capability therefore has no connected outcome path.

applied_domain.request: Design a growth and performance marketing AI system that evaluates outcomes, writes and adjusts copy, targeting and event definitions, and maximises a constrained objective. Show approval boundaries.

original_candidate.title: Constrained Growth Marketing AI Components
assumptions: Ad, email, web personalization, and product analytics systems expose APIs for telemetry reads and approved writes; no vendor choice is made here.
The marketer supplies objective, constraints, budget ceilings, brand rules, and protected-audience exclusions through the console.
Costly mutations such as budget increases, new audiences, event-schema changes, or external publication require explicit human approval.
Outcome feedback may update prompts, rankings, policies, or live configuration only through curated evidence, offline evaluation, reviewed release, canary, promotion, and rollback.
Raw user data is not used directly for training; reusable artifacts require validation, lifecycle management, lineage, and invalidation.
Internal retries are retry-safe: reserve before send, atomically deduplicate, validate before deliver, reconcile actual state, and compensate partial failures.

components.label: Growth Operations Console
components.responsibility: Marketer initiates objective, constraints, budget/brand limits, and exclusions; reviews ranked recommendations and approves or rejects costly external changes.

components.label: Campaign Orchestrator
components.responsibility: Runs optimization cycles from console intent; enforces reserve-before-send, validate-before-deliver, approval-before-publish, retry deduplication, and stop conditions.

components.label: Objective Constraint Policy Service
components.responsibility: Codifies KPI, constrained objective, spend ceilings, pacing, brand/legal rules, privacy exclusions; returns allow, deny, or require-approval before any mutation.

components.label: Experiment Decision Service
components.responsibility: Selects next copy, targeting, and event-definition actions to maximize the constrained objective; emits reservations, expected value, risk, and rollback hints.

components.label: Generative Copy Studio
components.responsibility: Drafts and adjusts channel-specific copy variants inside brand and policy bounds; reuses only validated approved prompts, claims, templates, and offers.

components.label: Targeting Event Definition Manager
components.responsibility: Proposes audience, bid, placement, and conversion-event definition changes; validates schemas, conflicts, privacy exclusions, and measurement impact before delivery.

components.label: Approval Boundary Service
components.responsibility: Owns human confirmation for costly or external mutations; records decision rights, evidence shown, expiry, approver outcome, and required compensation path.

components.label: Activation Executor
components.responsibility: Applies only approved changes to downstream marketing endpoints with idempotent retries, atomic deduplication, ordered reserve/send, reconciliation, and compensating reversal.

components.label: External Marketing Platforms
components.responsibility: External ad, email, web personalization, and analytics systems that receive approved mutations and return spend, delivery, and conversion outcomes.

components.label: Outcome Telemetry Ingestor
components.responsibility: Independently pulls platform and product outcome feeds; handles late, duplicate, and out-of-order events without driving optimization unless validated.

components.label: Golden Marketing Datastore
components.responsibility: Canonical raw store for impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, creative, audience, and event snapshots with ownership, lineage, retention, and privacy tags.

components.label: Metric Evaluation Attribution Service
components.responsibility: Validates and reconciles outcomes to experiments and decisions; computes objective progress, guardrail breaches, drift, and invalidated artifact signals.

components.label: Artifact Prompt Registry
components.responsibility: Versions prompts, templates, claims, audiences, rankings, and event definitions; manages reuse lifecycle, validation status, deprecation, and invalidation.

components.label: Context Feature Store
components.responsibility: Serves short-range campaign context and curated long-range facts with references to authoritative systems of record; never overrides policy constraints.

components.label: Offline Evaluation Release Gate
components.responsibility: Curates evidence, runs offline and regression evaluation, requires reviewed release, then owns canary, promotion, rollback for models, prompts, rankings, and live config.

components.label: Reconciliation Audit Service
components.responsibility: Compares intended reservations and approved writes against actual external state; detects partial failure, triggers compensation, and preserves audit trail.

components.label: Observability Runbook Service
components.responsibility: Tracks end-to-end latency, spend, failure isolation, races, drift alerts, SLOs, and graceful degradation; links incidents to release and rollback runbooks.

findings.reason: retrieval_or_reuse requires validation ownership by an executable component, but the only component that performs 'validation status' management for reused prompts/templates/claims/audiences is the Artifact Prompt Registry, which is a datastore; a datastore cannot execute evaluation or validation per the criteria, and no other component is described as validating reused artifacts before reuse (Generative Copy Studio only consumes 'validated' artifacts without owning the validation step).

Reconciliation and compensation for external writes are owned by two separate components without a clear single owner: Activation Executor claims 'reconciliation, and compensating reversal' while Reconciliation Audit Service separately claims 'detects partial failure, triggers compensation' and reconciliation against actual external state, duplicating the same material responsibility.

findings.reason: The request explicitly asks the system to 'evaluate outcomes,' but no candidate component owns outcome evaluation/measurement of campaign results; Experiment Decision Service only selects next actions and Objective Constraint Policy Service only enforces limits, leaving outcome evaluation without an owner.

learning_or_release is declared true and assumptions state outcome feedback may update prompts, rankings, policies, or live configuration only through curated evidence, offline evaluation, reviewed release, canary, promotion, and rollback, but no record names an owner performing curated-evidence collection, offline evaluation, canary rollout, promotion, or rollback for prompts/policies/rankings; existing components (Objective Constraint Policy Service, Experiment Decision Service, Approval Boundary Service) cover policy enforcement and human approval of mutations but not the model/prompt/config release lifecycle.

The learning_or_release flag is unsupported: no component's responsibility shows it changing a model, prompt, ranking, or live configuration based on feedback with the required curated-evidence/offline-eval/canary/promotion/rollback lifecycle; Generative Copy Studio and Targeting Event Definition Manager only validate and deliver content/definitions, they do not own the release lifecycle for feedback-driven configuration changes.
